Foreign Exchange Management (Overseas Investment) – Reporting through the FIRMS portal

RBI/2025-26/12

A.P. (DIR Series) Circular No. 07

April 22, 2025

To
All Category-I Authorised Dealer Banks

Madam / Sir,

Foreign Exchange Management (Overseas Investment) – Reporting through the FIRMS portal

Attention of Authorised Dealer Category-I (AD Category-I) banks is invited to the Foreign Exchange Management (Overseas Investment) Directions, 2022, in terms of which certain overseas investment transactions are required to be reported to the Reserve Bank.

2. It has been decided that, with effect from May 15, 2025, the Form ODI Part I and the Annual Performance Report shall be filed only through the Foreign Investment Reporting and Management System (FIRMS) portal. AD Category-I banks shall ensure that the reporting is completed within 30 days of the transaction.

3. Late submission of the reports shall attract a late submission fee as specified in the Directions.

4. AD Category-I banks may bring the contents of this circular to the notice of their constituents concerned.

5. The directions contained in this circular have been issued under sections 10(4) and 11(1) of the Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 (42 of 1999).

Yours faithfully,

(Arun Mehta)
General Manager
